senses.gloss: कैवर्त m. A fisherman, मनोभूः कैवर्तः क्षिपति परितस्त्वां प्रतिमुहुः (तनूजालीजालम्) Sant.S.iii.16. See M.x.84.
कैवल्य n. 1. Perfect isolation, exclusiveness; 2. individuality; 3. detachment of the soul from matter, becoming one with the supreme spirit, final emancipation or beatitude.
